# Share, Kwara

Share (Saare) is an ancient Yoruba town in Ifelodun Local Government Area of Kwara State, Nigeria.
Share is the headquarters of Ifelodun Local Government Area.about 64 Kilometres from Ilorin the state capital of Kwara state. The people of Share belong to the Igbomina extract of Yoruba tribe.
TOURIST ATTRACTION IN SHARE TOWN
* Spring goddess called Soose Spring Odò Soose
* Agbonna Hill called Òkè Àgbonnà
* Stillborn's Cave called Kòtò-Àbíkú
* Mysterious Tree called Igi-Aìmò
Prominent Higher institutions in Share Town
* Adeshina College of Education
* UMCA Bible College
Notable people
*Abdulfatah Ahmed Governor of Kwara State)
*Balogun of Share Alhaji AbdulAzeez Ismail Balogun. First Ifelodun Local Government councillor for Works, Land and Housing. He was the Ifelodun LGA, National Party of Nigeria Chairman and the Chairman Kwara Sate Rural Electrification Board from 1979 - 1983. Born Oct 12, 1924. Died June 6, 2009.
